name: docs-growth
description: Growth-reasoning pipeline over a product source-of-truth. Three pinned subagents (segment-analyst, funnel-analyst, competitor-analyst) reason about who buys, how they enter, and who competes — grounded in real analytics via docs-insights where data exists, simulated only where it cannot — and append what they learn back into the private knowledge base (about/, product-marketing context, etc.). Proposes and enriches; never touches product code or client docs. Emits schema-validated JSON consumable by downstream opportunity-mapping or experiment-planning agents.
